name: Saturn USD
redeem: Saturn lists this as its cross-chain USDat contract on Monad. Saturn documents direct minting and redemption with USDC or M0's $M only through its onboarded canonical issuance flow; a Monad-local issuer redemption route is not documented. Exit therefore depends on secondary liquidity or a separately supported cross-chain route.
notes: This is USDat, not the supplied Pendle PT. The documented canonical USDat contract is on Ethereum, so the Monad representation adds cross-chain transport and local-liquidity risk to the underlying permissioned stablecoin risk.
